title: Government Launches First Phase of Census 2027 — First Fully Digital & Caste-Enumerating Census
summary: Phase I (House Listing) of Census 2027 launched on April 1, 2026 with ₹11,718.24 Cr budget—first digital census & 1st caste count since 1931.

blocks.content: Government launched **Phase I of Census 2027 (16th overall, 8th post-independence)** on April 1, 2026, marking India's first smartphone/portal-based digital census.

items: **2 Phases**: Phase I (House Listing: Apr-Sep 2026) | Phase II (Population & Caste Enumeration: Feb 2027). Total budget: **₹11,718.24 crore**.
**Self-Enumeration**: Citizens can self-enumerate via portal in 16 languages, generating an 11-digit SE ID.

provenance.sourceTitle: Government Launches First Phase of Census 2027 — First Fully Digital & Caste-Enumerating Census
